name: benchmarks_v1
notes: Results are kept per dataset and per evidence class; nothing is pooled across datasets or across synthetic and real data. No ranking is made.
Self-consistency (SR reduced to the LR grid vs the LR) is reported separately and is not accuracy against an HR reference.

provenance.name: bicubic
provenance.operator: frame.validation.bicubic_upsample: bicubic interpolation with antialiasing, negatives clamped to 0
provenance.value_convention: reflectance fraction = stored DN / the dataset's reflectance_scale (10000); no BOA offset applied, no clipping by FRAME

provenance.name: sen2sr_lite
provenance.note: the published inference system: CNN + clamp to >= 0 + low-frequency Fourier hard constraint (512x512 mask) inside every tile
provenance.value_convention: reflectance fraction = stored DN / the dataset's reflectance_scale (10000); no BOA offset applied, no clipping by FRAME

provenance.name: sen2sr_lite_no_constraint
provenance.note: the same CNN with its output clamped to >= 0 exactly as the published wrapper does before its constraint; the hard constraint is NOT applied (an ablation, not the intended system)
provenance.value_convention: reflectance fraction = stored DN / the dataset's reflectance_scale (10000); no BOA offset applied, no clipping by FRAME

provenance.name: sen2sr_mamba
provenance.note: SEN2SR-Mamba RGBN through the isolated worker: MambaSR + clamp to >= 0 + low-frequency hard constraint, float32 (no autocast)
provenance.value_convention: reflectance fraction = stored DN / the dataset's reflectance_scale (10000); no BOA offset applied, no clipping by FRAME

provenance.note: a frozen model trained by frame.train WITHOUT the low-frequency hard constraint; not the published SEN2SR system

training.overlap_check: performed against the train and validation scenes listed in train_summary
